segments.name: Operating container carriers
segments.description: Operates a fleet of containerships providing worldwide ocean-going transportation of dry and refrigerated containerized cargoes for charterers.
segments.evidence: the Company has determined that it operates under one operating and one reportable segment, that of operating container carriers.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay the company daily time charter rates and voyage charter revenues for employing its containerships.
revenueModel.evidence: we generated time charter and voyage charter revenues totaling $195.8 million, $219.4 million and $234.44 million respectively.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company spun off three subsidiaries owning older vessels into Euroholdings Ltd., which became an independent publicly traded company.
changes.evidence: Euroseas distributed all of Euroholdings' common shares to its shareholders on a pro rata basis on March 17, 2025.
